reviewer: Assistant preliminary visual audit; NOT a release sign-off

F01.finding: Collar reads as a thick ring; its folded layered profile does not match the reference.
F01.required_change: Resculpt curved folded lip, lower the front and preserve face clearance.

F02.finding: Front shoulders are wide, almost horizontal and angular versus softly sloping reference.
F02.required_change: Reshape the garment shoulder silhouette and armhole transition.

F03.finding: Cuffs form outward triangular wings and sleeve length does not match the close-up.
F03.required_change: Extend relaxed sleeve fabric to reference length; form gentle continuous opening.

F04.finding: Upper torso is a broad flat slab, rather than subtle anatomical waist taper.
F04.required_change: Rework torso circumference and fabric drape.

F05.finding: Only faint smooth shading; three asymmetric gathered fabric folds are not visible.
F05.required_change: Sculpt loose waist folds with actual geometric depth and soft light response.

F06.finding: Bottom is a hard horizontal shelf and not a gathered cloth hem overlapping gray shorts.
F06.required_change: Tailor soft double hem and remove hard sheet edge.

F07.finding: Candidate navy is visibly brighter and more uniform than dark muted knit in supplied close-up.
F07.required_change: Match material and roughness under consistent lighting.

F08.finding: Candidate front is plain navy with no visible fan or red atlas bleed.

B01.finding: Back collar is a straight thick tube and visually crowds tied-back hair.
B01.required_change: Sculpt tapered layered cloth collar around neck.

B02.finding: Crest is egg-shaped; red section is vertically elongated and white bowl is undersized.
B02.required_change: Correct entire fan geometry and white lower fan shape.

B03.finding: Crest is too narrow relative to upper-back shirt width (visually about 25% vs 33–42% target).

B04.finding: Sleeves project outward as angular flanges and rear shoulders are boxy.
B04.required_change: Rework sewn shoulder slope and cuffs from back view.

B05.finding: Lower back too flat and rectangular, missing reference gathered side folds.
B05.required_change: Resculpt soft hanging back fabric and hem.

B06.finding: Crest lies on fabric in idle view, but distortion under movement has not been checked.
B06.required_change: Render logo under torso twist and check texture deformation.

D01.finding: Localized color check reported no exposed skin, but rendered armhole silhouette still looks pinched and spike-like.
D01.required_change: Inspect whole upper shoulder rather than one small pixel box; repair sleeve silhouette.

D02.finding: Posed sleeves still appear unnaturally pinched/creased around shoulders.
D02.required_change: Inspect shoulder continuity under guard and jab at multiple angles.

D03.finding: Latest GLB exports original 44-joint skin, continuous torso-and-sleeves mesh, UVs and normals; structural test passed.

D04.finding: No full run, kick, cross, and dodge garment proof images are present.
D04.required_change: Produce those four pose render sequences and inspect clipping.

P01.finding: Source vs candidate has been compared, but side-by-side matching viewpoints and full animation proof set are incomplete.
P01.required_change: Generate aligned source/render comparisons and all required combat views.

P02.finding: Candidate remains on art/v5-garment-sculpt-gated and has not been merged to main.
P02.required_change: Continue isolating all iterations and block release until accepted.
